name: Tornado Sandbox Game (DOM3)
desc:
*This game will NOT run well on low end devices.*

Tornado Sandbox Game was created by Claymaker225, FoundVulnez and Bomer. 

Throughout Tornado Sandbox Game, there are over 25 variants of tornadoes you can receive. Ranging from slow and weak, to powerful and rapid moving tornades. Though, there are MORE tornadoes to be added to the game so expected even more variants of tornadoes.

Claymaker225 - Lead Developer / Owner, Programmer.
FoundVulnez - Programmer.
Bomer - VFX, Vehicle Designer.
